hospital_name: Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital Drogheda
source: National Treatment Purchase Fund (NTPF), Open Data — Waiting List Data

ipdc.methodology_note: Pre-2021 figures summed across Inpatient + Day Case and all specialties for comparability with the combined post-2021 reporting format. Time bands grouped into Under 6 / 6-12 / 12+ months by starting wait length, since NTPF's own band boundaries changed at the same point (2022+ files use 0-6/6-12/12-18/18+ months; pre-2021 files use 0-3/3-6/6-9/9-12/12+ months) and are not directly comparable band-for-band.
ipdc.known_limitations: Adult and Child are NTPF's own classification (no further age breakdown is published). A hospital with no patients in a population shows an empty chart for that toggle rather than being hidden.

op.methodology_note: Outpatient appointments have no Inpatient/Day Case split to sum across (a single appointment type), unlike IPDC. Time bands grouped into Under 6 / 6-12 / 12+ months by starting wait length, since NTPF's own band boundaries changed at the same point (2022+ files use 0-6/6-12/12-18/18+ months; pre-2021 files use 0-3/3-6/6-9/9-12/12+ months) and are not directly comparable band-for-band. Outpatient data is only available from 2018 onward — NTPF has not published OP data for 2014-2017, unlike IPDC which covers the full range.
op.known_limitations: Adult and Child are NTPF's own classification (no further age breakdown is published). A hospital with no patients in a population shows an empty chart for that toggle rather than being hidden.
